name: Haunted Doll Cabinet
disable: DC 16 Occultism check (trained) or DC 16 Religion check (trained) to calm the spirits of one of three shelves in the cabinet
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures have left the area or when the soulbound dolls in the northwestern cabinet are destroyed. After 1 hour, the haunt is ready to trigger again. Putting Thalleus's spirit to rest permanently destroys the haunt.
routine: (3 actions) For each shelf that remains, the haunt takes 1 action to target a living, non-construct creature in the room. Phantom dolls escape from the cabinet to rush that creature, clamber over them, and punch, kick, and bite them. The target takes 1d6+2 spirit damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: On Display
items.text:
Trigger At least two living creatures are in the room for more than a minute

---
Effect The dolls in the cabinet begin to shake and shudder, filling the area with a feeling of overwhelming dread about what might happen next. Each living creature who can see the cabinet must succeed at a DC 20 Will save save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: Three shelves inside a dusty cabinet each hold a row of dolls infused with the Doll House's malevolent spiritual energy.
